senses.gloss: m. Ar.) (זהר, cmp. זהה a. זהם) [a glittering substance,]
gall (cmp. Syr. זהרא P. Sm. 1091, זהירא acerbus, ib. 1090); trnsf. anger, injured pride.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 45b:12">Gitt. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>אימליא ז׳</he> she was filled with gall (anger).

senses.gloss: venom, a fatal substance discharged by animals of prey on attacking.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30b:5">Ab. Zar. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>זִיהֲרֵיה חליש</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>זיהרא קליש</he>) its (the serpent’s) poison grows weaker with old age.
<cite ref="Chullin 53a:9">Ḥull. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>שדי זיהריה</he> it discharges its venom.
<cite ref="Chullin 52b:17">Ib. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ אית ליה … זיהריה</he> it issues a fluid but its discharge does not burn.

<cite ref="Niddah 55b:49">Nidd. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>נהי דז׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דזהי׳</he>, corr. acc.) though the poison is removed from the body (through the secretion of the nose), the fluid itself (put in the eye) is not removed.
